_about: Draft owner acceptance checks for the 13 feature specs. Wording remains draft until the owner approves it; test IDs are enforced by TRACE-01.

acceptanceChecks.given: A valid list of barcode or QR values
acceptanceChecks.when: the user exports an Avery sheet with one code per label
acceptanceChecks.then: every value appears once, spans additional pages when needed, and scans back correctly

acceptanceChecks.given: Any registered barcode format and its valid default or supported edge input
acceptanceChecks.then: the registry is valid and an independent decoder returns the intended value

acceptanceChecks.given: A supported barcode and visible style controls
acceptanceChecks.when: the user changes colour, padding, scale, height, text, or corners
acceptanceChecks.then: the preview changes and supported exports preserve the chosen styling

acceptanceChecks.given: A sequence or pasted list within the documented limit
acceptanceChecks.when: the user exports a ZIP or Avery PDF
acceptanceChecks.then: each valid value is exported once and invalid or excess lines are reported

acceptanceChecks.given: A documented studio or legacy deep link
acceptanceChecks.then: the intended format, wizard, payload and modal state open safely and legacy links retain their query

acceptanceChecks.when: the user downloads PNG, SVG, EPS or PDF
acceptanceChecks.then: the file is valid, matches the preview's data and supported styling, and scans independently

acceptanceChecks.given: An EAN-13, UPC-A or ISBN barcode with human-readable text
acceptanceChecks.then: guard bars extend by 5X and the leading digit uses the standard outside position

acceptanceChecks.given: Codes created in the studio, including unsafe-looking text
acceptanceChecks.when: history records, restores or clears them
acceptanceChecks.then: history stays bounded, avoids partial entries, restores the value, and never executes markup

acceptanceChecks.given: A supported code and label preset
acceptanceChecks.when: the user edits the layout and exports or prints it
acceptanceChecks.then: the label dimensions, text and encoded value agree, including an empty-by-default Amazon FNSKU

acceptanceChecks.given: A barcode or label with a documented physical size
acceptanceChecks.when: the user exports PNG, SVG or EPS
acceptanceChecks.then: the file carries matching physical dimensions and required quiet zones

acceptanceChecks.given: A QR code with supported dots, eyes, colours, gradient, padding, logo or corners
acceptanceChecks.when: the user previews and exports it
acceptanceChecks.then: the chosen appearance is preserved and the result remains independently scannable

acceptanceChecks.given: Any supported QR wizard with valid inputs
acceptanceChecks.when: the user selects it or edits its fields
acceptanceChecks.then: the correct fields appear and the decoded payload follows that format's rules

acceptanceChecks.given: An uploaded image or camera stream containing a supported code
acceptanceChecks.then: the reader returns the value locally, handles unsafe content as text, and can hand safe data to the studio
